import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Force kill all node and restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pkill -9 -f 'tsx\\|node.*index' 2>&1 || true")
time.sleep(3)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && nohup npx tsx src/index.ts > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &")
time.sleep(25)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP:", stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -8 /tmp/server.log")
print("Log:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
